metadata.title: Hypersurfaces with Non-diagonalizable Shape Operators in Minkowski Spaces
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study hypersurfaces $M^4$ in the Minkowski space $\mathbb{E}^5_1$ whose shape operator $S$ is non-diagonalizable, having a triple real eigenvalue $\lambda$ with a one-dimensional eigenspace together with a simple eigenvalue $\mu$ (Case~(iii) in the classification of Magid). Assuming that $\lambda$ and $\mu$ satisfy a functional relation $\lambda=f(\mu)$ and that the eigenvector field of $\mu$ is geodesic, we show that $\lambda$ and $\mu$, as well as the pseudo-orthonormal frame, are intrinsic invariants of $M$, determined by the induced metric up to sign. As a consequence, we prove that such hypersurfaces are unique up to isometries of $\mathbb{E}^5_1$. We also obtain a classification of the warped product hypersurfaces of this type.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 研究五维 Minkowski 空间中四维超曲面的一类不可对角化形算子；在两特征值有函数关系、单特征值的特征向量场为测地线场时，证明特征值及伪正交标架由内蕴度量决定到符号，进而得到环境等距意义下唯一性与翘曲积分类。
techniques: 形算子的 Jordan 类型
analysis.breakthrough: 在指定的非对角化类型下获得由内蕴度量决定的外在刚性。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。仅覆盖 Magid 分类的指定情形并附带函数依赖与测地性假设，不是所有 Lorentz 超曲面的刚性结论。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
